title: Register a new account and reach the correct landing page
description: This verifies that a new visitor can create an account successfully and proceed to the appropriate signed-in landing page for their role.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the name field with a new user name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify an account created confirmation is visible
Verify the user reaches the appropriate landing page for the account role

Submit the login form
Verify the appropriate signed-in landing page is displayed
